title: Z-Image Turbo Face Detailing Workflow
summary: A high-performance ComfyUI workflow optimized for facial enhancement using Alibaba's Z-Image Turbo 6B DiT model. It utilizes a precision crop-and-inpainting pipeline with YOLOv8 and SAM to deliver high-fidelity skin textures in just 8-10 steps.
research_notes: Requires the Qwen 2.5 VL text encoder and specific VAE for optimal results; significantly outpaces traditional SDXL detailers in speed-to-quality ratio.

evolution.summary: The Z-Image project evolved from heavy DiT models into the distilled 'Turbo' version to enable real-time detailing. It has since been integrated into the 'Z-Image Power Nodes' ecosystem, supporting advanced features like low-sigma detailing and specialized facial LoRAs.
